{{infobox TRL
Maintainer: Hugging Face
Version: 1.17.1
LoRA RL: Yes, through PEFT
Multi-turn: <code>GRPOTrainer(environment_factory=…)</code>
Rollouts: vLLM, colocated or server mode
DGX Spark: Unverified
Verdict: Recommended main tool}}

'''TRL''' is Hugging Face's post-training library.<ref>[https://github.com/huggingface/trl TRL repository]</ref> Its <code>GRPOTrainer</code> accepts an environment class and turns that class's methods into tools the model can call, which is the shape of a browser agent.

== Why it is the main pick ==
{{youtube 4uLEMtAdQCM Fine-tuning with SFT, PPO and GRPO using TRL|Ricardo Calix}}

* It ships a '''BrowserGym GRPO example''' (MiniWoB and WebArena through OpenEnv), with an accessibility-tree text variant and a screenshot variant.<ref>[https://github.com/huggingface/trl/tree/main/examples/grpo_browsergym TRL grpo_browsergym example]</ref>
* The docs and courses are beginner-level. See [[learning-path]].
* vLLM '''server mode''' can run the generator on one machine (the [[rtx-pro-6000|PRO 6000s]]) and the trainer on another (the [[dgx-spark|Sparks]]).

== Watch out for ==
* Spark support is only mentioned in a user issue.<ref>[https://github.com/huggingface/trl/issues/6294 TRL issue #6294]</ref> Test on one Spark first.
* The async trainer is still experimental.

== Further reading ==
{{cards https://github.com/huggingface/trl/tree/main/examples/grpo_browsergym https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/en/openenv}}
